leads.arxiv: 2607.12893 (arXiv API: v1 2026-07-14; title: MemOps: Benchmarking Lifecycle Memory Operations in Long-Horizon Conversations)

community_list_entries.name: MemOps: Benchmarking Lifecycle Memory Operations in Long-Horizon Conversations

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A benchmark of lifecycle memory operations (remember, forget, update, reflect) in long task-oriented multi-session conversations. It uses gold operation traces and six probe types and has 2,006 QA pairs, with ~61K tokens in the long-context setting. It evaluates long-context, retrieval, managed-memo

phase1_verified_types.parametric: Sec. 4.1: 'we test the parameter-update baseline Temp-LoRA'. Sec. 1: 'Parametric memory, which folds interaction history directly into model parameters' is 'markedly unreliable'. Tables 3-5 score Temp-LoRA beside RAG, MemOS, Mem0 and long-context models.
